d: The Last Mile Team Leader is responsible for leading the daily operations related to the final stage of delivery — from hub dispatch to successful customer handover. This includes supervising couriers, ensuring accurate scanning and loading, monitoring delivery KPIs, and supporting issue resolution to meet service level standards.
q: Diploma or equivalent; degree in Logistics or related field is a plus
3–5 years of experience in last mile or courier operations, with team responsibility
Familiar with handheld scanners, route planning, and delivery performance metrics
r: li
Oversee and support couriers during vehicle loading and route execution.
li
Ensure all packages are scanned, sorted, and dispatched accurately and on time
li
Monitor performance in terms of On-Time Delivery (OTP) and First Attempt Success Rate.
li
Allocate daily tasks, routes, and shifts to couriers and support staff.
li
Ensure all team members follow SOPs for scanning, handling, and safety.
li
Provide on-the-ground guidance and coaching to improve efficiency.
li
Address minor on-route issues such as missing shipments or address errors.
li
Support the resolution of failed deliveries (NDR) in coordination with customer service.
li
Report system or courier-related issues to the supervisor.
li
Ensure all delivery updates are recorded in real-time using handheld devices.
li
Monitor courier tracking and upload data accuracy.
li
Submit end-of-day reports covering volumes, issues, and team attendance.

d: Mahally is a Saudi e-commerce marketplace by Salla that brings thousands of local stores together in one app, offering customers a wide range of products across fashion, beauty, electronics, home and more.

We are looking for a Marketing Communications Manager to lead Mahally's creative and social media direction. The role is responsible for creating campaign ideas and seasonal moments on social media, producing video content, and managing our work with influencers, UGC creators and creative agencies.
The Marketing Communications Manager works closely with the social media, design, performance marketing and category teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Advertising, Communications, Graphic Design , or a related field.
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in creative, content, social media, or related functions.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a senior, lead, or managerial role , with demonstrated ownership of creative strategy, content development, campaigns, or creative teams.
Strong portfolio demonstrating successful social media campaigns and video-first content , from concept development through execution.
Proven experience managing or collaborating with influencers, UGC creators, creative partners, and production agencies , preferably within the Saudi market.

Strong understanding of Saudi culture, consumer behaviour, digital trends, and the local social media landscape , with the ability to translate cultural insights into relevant and engaging creative content.
Hands-on experience across the video production lifecycle , including concept development, scripting/storyboarding, production, and post-production.
Professional proficiency in Arabic and English , with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong project and stakeholder management skills , with demonstrated ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative deliverables, agencies, and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Previous experience within a creative, advertising, digital, or social media agency .
Strong Arabic copywriting and content development skills, particularly for Saudi audiences and social platforms.
Working proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma , with the ability to review, develop, or provide direction on creative assets.
Hands-on experience using AI-powered image and video tools for creative ideation, content development, production, or optimization.
r: li
Lead the creative direction of Mahally's social media channels and ensure all content is consistent with the brand identity and tone of voice.
li
Develop creative concepts for key seasonal campaigns such as Saudi National Day, Founding Day, Ramadan, Eid and White Friday.
li
Plan and manage the annual social media content calendar in coordination with the marketing team.
li
Monitor trends on Saudi social media and turn relevant ones into timely content for Mahally.
li
Oversee video production from concept to final delivery, including scripts, storyboards, shoots and post-production.
li
Produce short-form video content for Snapchat, TikTok, Instagram and X.
li
Identify, contract and manage influencers and UGC creators, including briefing, content approval and performance tracking.
li
Brief and manage creative and production agencies, and ensure deliverables meet quality, timeline and budget requirements.
li
Develop and maintain social media brand guidelines.
li
Review and approve creative and social content before publishing.
li
Work with the performance marketing team to test creatives and use the results to improve future content.
li
Manage the creative, production and influencer budget and report on spend and results.
